title: Measuring AI activity instead of business improvement
summary: Connect usage to accepted work and accepted work to an actual business outcome.
diagnosis: Logins, tokens, drafts and generated code measure activity. They can help diagnose adoption and cost but do not establish quality, use or value. Even time saved is incomplete until the organisation understands what happens to the released capacity. Define a chain from participation to changed workflow to accepted output to the result the business or customer values.
diagnostic_questions: What was the pre-change baseline, and are the compared cases similar in difficulty and volume?
Does “completed” mean generated, reviewed, accepted, used or resolved for the customer?
Where are checking, correction, escalation and displaced downstream work included?
proposed_actions: Choose an existing business measure, add quality and risk guardrails, and define the unit of accepted work before rollout.
Collect active effort and end-to-end time separately; use a comparison design appropriate to the decision and document its limitations.
Record whether released capacity becomes more throughput, better service, less overtime or a realised cost change; do not count all of these as the same benefit.
working_artifact: Measurement contract: unit of work; acceptance definition; eligible population; baseline period; comparison approach; outcome measure; quality floor; review/rework accounting; benefit owner; known confounders.
measures: Cost per accepted task = total attributable operating and review cost divided by tasks meeting the declared acceptance standard; show excluded failures separately.
End-to-end resolution time and repeat-contact or rework rate for comparable cases.
Realised capacity use or customer outcome, distinguishing measured change from an untested attribution to AI.
tradeoff: Not every pilot permits a randomised design, and not every outcome appears quickly. Report uncertainty rather than replace missing evidence with usage. Research about task use or assessed ideas should not be promoted into claims about realised enterprise profit.
illustrative_case: Illustrative application: an assistant doubles drafts produced, but managers reject more of them and the publishing queue grows. The activity metric improves while accepted delivery and customer value remain unchanged.
